description: Finds statutory instruments (regulations and orders) laid before the UK Parliament by words in their name, with the procedure they follow (for example draft affirmative or negative), laying dates in each House, made date and SI number where issued. For compliance and legal teams asking what regulations were just laid on a topic and how Parliament will deal with them. Source: UK Parliament Statutory Instruments API. It covers laying and procedure, not the regulation text (see legislation.gov.uk). (cost: 1 credit)

q.description: string, required, word or phrase in the instrument name, e.g. pension

take.description: integer, optional, results to return 1-100, default 10

name: statutory_instrument_search
